en.meta.title: BLOCKNATOR.COM — Modular Token Infrastructure
en.meta.description: BLOCKNATOR: Web3 infrastructure that stores, organizes and presents token projects across multiple blockchains. One ecosystem. Multiple projects.
en.hero.subtitle: MODULAR TOKEN INFRASTRUCTURE
en.hero.description: Web3 infrastructure that stores, organizes, documents and presents token projects across multiple blockchains. Each project operates independently on its own network.
en.gallery.title: Gallery
en.gallery.description: Visual gallery of the projects in the BLOCKNATOR ecosystem.
en.directory.title: Directory
en.directory.description: Central token directory. Search by name or ticker, filter by blockchain.
en.directory.empty: No tokens found with those criteria.
en.about.title: About BLOCKNATOR
en.about.p1: BLOCKNATOR is a modular Web3 infrastructure that stores, organizes and presents token projects across multiple blockchains. All projects belong to the BLOCKNATOR ecosystem but operate independently on their respective networks.
en.about.hasList1: Stores information and files for the projects.
en.about.hasList3: Presents the projects through a gallery.
en.about.hasList4: Provides access to the official Web3 pages.
en.about.archP1: Ultralight 100% client-side architecture: zero backend, zero databases, zero heavy frameworks. The static server only delivers files; your browser interprets and runs them using HTML5, CSS3, native JavaScript and JSON.
en.about.principleVanillaDesc: No React, Vue, Angular or Node.js.
en.about.principleNoAuthDesc: No sign-up, no private keys, no cookies.
en.about.principleMultiDesc: Independent projects on their own blockchains.
en.footer.copyright: © {year} BLOCKNATOR. Demo projects for illustrative purposes.
